ci-bot: · Pipeline FAILED on main after merge · build=4621 · stage=canary-smoke · job=model-serve-smoke · reason=grpc timeout (ctx deadline exceeded). logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/build/4621

anna: who is on call for infra? this just came in during lunch.

mike: i was about to step out, but i'm around for 15. pinging @dave-oncall

dave-oncall: taking it — i'll triage. any quick blamelist? commit 9f3b2c4 (merge: feat/req-caching).

sophia: fwiw the merge touched the grpc client config in orchestration, but test only exercises canary. possible infra flake too.

dave-oncall: pulling logs now. showing repeated CONNECT failed entries and timeout at ~30s. snippet:
```
E0421 12:03:29.123 1 grpc: failed to dial backend: context deadline exceeded
E0421 12:03:29.124 1 serve: canary healthcheck timeout
```

katie: can we /retest the job or re-run the canary stage? prefer rerun before bisect.

mike: re-run started: https://ci.internal/redwood/build/4622 (manual retry by @mike)

sre-bot: Autoscaler spikes detected in region-us-west-2 around 12:02 — rolling infra maintenance window? ops might have brief networking flap.

anna: ok — if infra noisy, likely transient. but keep an eye for reproducible failures.

dave-oncall: second run shows same failure pattern? waiting for logs, but early look: more transient connection resets, not a deterministic unit test failure.

mike: build 4622 finished — SUCCESS on model-serve-smoke.

dave-oncall: marking this as infra transient. filing a short incident note and will watch next 3 runs. no revert or bisect for now.

anna: thanks @dave-oncall and @mike — closing the alert for now. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Note: if it fails again 3x in a row, automation will open a rerun/bisect ticket.
